title: Dow has best post-midterm elections day in 44 years as Democrats take control of Congress
summary: Democrats swept both chambers of Congress on Nov 3. Dow rose ~3% on Nov 4, its best post-midterm session in 44 years; S&P 500 and Nasdaq also climbed. Trump accepted the results, reducing fears of a prolonged dispute.
why: 美国政治格局改变：民主党国会或推动科技监管及AI政策调整，对持仓科技板块估值与期权隐含波动率有深远影响；后续AI抛售即源于此次选举结果

title: AI meltdown: Nvidia and Qualcomm drop more than 9%, pushing Nasdaq to worst day since April 2025
summary: Nasdaq fell 5.5% on Nov 5 — worst since April 2025. Philadelphia Semiconductor Index plunged 12.2%, biggest drop since 2020. Nvidia fell ~9%, losing ~50B in market cap. Trigger: investor fears that Democratic Congress will restrict AI data-center construction and tighten tech regulation.
why: 英伟达跌~9%，费城半导体指数创4年最大单日跌幅；对AI芯片/GPU持仓构成直接冲击；隐含波动率大幅飙升，covered call和sell put策略需重新评估；港股科技板块联动受压

title: AI stocks hammered by midterm shock as data center buildout becomes a "war of attrition"
summary: CNBC analysis: even though Congress changes hands only in January and state-level AI restrictions still need to pass, investors treated the Democratic sweep as an immediate threat to AI data center expansion, sending AI and chip stocks into prolonged selling.
why: AI数据中心政策前景不确定性上升，投资者担忧数据中心扩建放缓，AI基础设施板块估值逻辑受到挑战；影响英伟达、美光、SK海力士等持仓

title: U.S. Adds 165,000 Jobs in October, Topping All Forecasts; Unemployment Falls to 4.1%
summary: October payrolls rose 165,000, beating all estimates; prior months revised up 53,000. Unemployment edged down to 4.1%. Private-sector growth was the strongest since March. Fed has one more jobs print before its December 8-9 meeting.
why: 就业强劲、失业率走低增强美联储12月再加息预期，债券收益率上行压力或拖累成长股估值；同时减缓衰退担忧，半导体板块Nov 6局部反弹（英伟达+2.8%，AMD+11%）与强劲就业数据有关

title: Tech stocks lead declines in Hong Kong, mainland China on US.3 trillion carnage in US
summary: Hong Kong and China tech stocks fell sharply on Nov 6, tracking the US.3 trillion rout in US markets on Nov 5. Hang Seng Index dropped 1.27%, while A-share tech and AI-linked hardware names were among the worst performers.
why: 港股/A股科技股联动美股重挫；恒生指数跌1.27%，A股创业板跌3.96%；持仓中港股科技标的（腾讯、阿里、美团等）估值承压，可关注期权隐含波动率变化

title: 新浪A股热点速递：三大指数全线收跌，上证指数跌1.10%，创业板指跌3.96%
summary: 11月6日收盘：上证指数跌1.10%至3649.18点，深证成指跌2.57%，创业板指跌3.96%，科创50跌2.60%，北证50跌2.37%。全市场成交额约1.67万亿元，超4700只个股下跌，通信设备（CPO概念）领跌。
why: 美股AI抛售拖累A股科技与算力板块；创业板跌近4%，全市场超4700只个股下跌；持仓中A股科技类标的承压，注意期权策略（sell put保护位）的调整

title: Palantir reports booming U.S. commercial revenue growth, topping government for first time
summary: Q3 revenue .313B (+96% YoY), beat est. .18B; adj. EPS /bin/bash.44 vs est. /bin/bash.41. US commercial revenue surged 148% to 84M, surpassing US government revenue (53M) for the first time. Full-year 2026 guidance raised to .53B (from .15B). Q4 guidance ~.65B vs est. ~.46B.
why: 延续报道：Q3超预期业绩于5天前发布，US商业收入首超政府收入为AI平台商业化拐点；随后AI监管恐慌引发抛售使PLTR估值承压，可结合回调关注sell put机会

title: Apple Intelligence to roll out on iPhones in China in December with Alibaba backing
summary: Apple confirmed Apple Intelligence launches in China in December via iOS 27.3, with Alibaba's Qwen model powering Siri, Writing Tools and Visual Intelligence. Developer beta testing started Nov 4. BABA surged ~6% on the announcement (made on Oct 31). Advanced Siri features are not in the first rollout.
why: 延续报道：苹果AI入华以通义千问为底层，直接验证阿里云AI商业化能力，5天前BABA股价急涨~6%；12月发布窗口仍在演进，对阿里期权持仓（sell put）有正面支撑

title: Circle reports $865 million in Q3 revenue and reserve income, discloses 5% workforce reduction
summary: Circle (CRCL) Q3 revenue $865M (+17% YoY). USDC circulation $73.9B (flat QoQ, +16% YoY). Arc presale added $182M in revenue. Company cut 5% of workforce. Full-year 2026 guidance maintained.
why: 延续报道：Circle Q3营收3天前发布，增速17%放缓且裁员5%；USDC流通量未显著增长，但Arc新产品值得关注；稳定币监管（GENIUS Act）进展将影响CRCL估值与sell put的安全边际
